fusions.name: Head-Down Rush
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles to the target and deals 12 damage, up to 1.5 times as much from the full 6 tiles, knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Herd Stomp
fusions.desc: A plated stomp that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. If it hits, your party deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Yoked Endurance
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 15% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow-Built Hide
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they spend at once and you gain a shield worth 4% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
